question: Where was the Muslim League founded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhaka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The All-India Muslim League **was a **political party **established in **1906 in British India**.
 
• The **party arose out **of the **need for the political representation of Muslims **in **British India**, especially in the event of the **Indian National Congress-sponsored massive Hindu **opposition to the **1905 partition of Bengal**.
 
• It led the **movement calling **for **a separate Muslim nation **to be **created **at the **time of the partition of British India (1947).**
 
• The **Muslim League **was **founded in 1906 **to **safeguard **the **rights of Indian Muslims**.
 
• **Khwaja salimullah **was the **founder **of **Muslim league**.
 
• **Around 3000 delegates **attended a **conference of the Muhammadan Educational Conference **in **Dhaka on 30 December 1906**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Hindu Mahasabha **(All-India Hindu Grand Assembly) is a **Hindu nationalist political party **in **India**. It was **Founded in 1915**, the Mahasabha functioned mainly as **a pressure group advocating **the interests of orthodox Hindus before the British Raj and within the Indian National Congress.
 
• The **National-Christian Defense League **was **a far-right political party **of **Romania **formed by **A. C. Cuza. National-Christian Defense League**.
